local d=34 local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') local a=f and f:FindFirstChild('Discovery1') local ch=game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character local h=ch and ch:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart') if not a then return 'NOANCHOR' end local RS=game:GetService('RunService') pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep('DfCam') end) if h then h.Anchored=true h.CFrame=CFrame.new(a.Position+Vector3.new(0,2,d)) end RS:BindToRenderStep('DfCam',Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value+1,function() local c=workspace.CurrentCamera c.CameraType=Enum.CameraType.Scriptable local p=a.Position c.CFrame=CFrame.lookAt(p+Vector3.new(d*0.7,d*0.35+4,d*0.7),p+Vector3.new(0,2,0)) end) return 'cam '..d

local f=workspace:FindFirstChild('FieldScene') local out={} if f then out[#out+1]='target='..tostring(f:GetAttribute('FieldTargetCard'))..' arch='..tostring(f:GetAttribute('FieldDiscoveryArchetype'))..' method='..tostring(f:GetAttribute('FieldDiscoveryMethod'))..' weather='..tostring(f:GetAttribute('FieldWeather')) local forms,traces,sil,vis=0,0,0,0 for _,x in f:GetDescendants() do if x.Name:sub(1,18)=='FieldDiscoveryForm' then forms+=1 end if x.Name:sub(1,19)=='FieldDiscoveryTrace' then traces+=1 end if x:IsA('Highlight') and x.Name=='DiscoverySilhouette' then sil+=1 end if x:IsA('BasePart') and x.Name:sub(1,9)=='Discovery' and x.Transparency<1 then vis+=1 end end out[#out+1]=string.format('forms=%d traces=%d silhouettes=%d visibleBalls=%d',forms,traces,sil,vis) local a=f:FindFirstChild('Discovery1') local pp=a and a:FindFirstChildOfClass('ProximityPrompt') out[#out+1]='prompt='..tostring(pp and pp.ActionText)..' hold='..tostring(pp and pp.HoldDuration) end local DF=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.DiscoveryForms) local KC=require(game.ReplicatedStorage.Shared.KnowledgeCards) for _,id in ipairs({'zoo_puffin','bot_tulip','site_parthenon','min_quartz','relic_astrolabe'}) do local c=KC.ById[id] local fm=c and DF.form(c) out[#out+1]=id..'='..tostring(fm and fm.archetype)..'/'..tostring(fm and fm.missing) end local lib=game.ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild('MareAssets') local an=lib and lib:FindFirstChild('Animals') out[#out+1]='animals='..tostring(an and #an:GetChildren())..' elephant='..tostring(an and an:FindFirstChild('elephant')~=nil) return 'DF '..table.concat(out,' | ')
